## Summary

**Problem:** checkout-api was failing health checks after the v2.3.1 deploy.

**Actions taken:**
1. **Reviewed deployment history** — confirmed v2.3.1 was unhealthy and v2.3.0 was the most recent release healthy in production.
2. **Rolled back to v2.3.0 in all production regions.** The first attempt partially failed (us-east rolled back, but an orchestrator error halted us-west and eu-west); a retry completed the rollout.
3. **Verified recovery** — all three regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) are now on v2.3.0, healthy, with error rate down from 18% to 0.2%.
4. **Opened SEV2 incident INC-0001** documenting the failure, the rollback (including the partial-failure/retry), and the need to investigate v2.3.1 and the orchestrator error before any redeploy.

**Note:** v2.3.1 has never been healthy in production, so redeploying it (or any new version) will require change-manager approval per policy.
